The MyTEAM NBA-WNBA crossover is officially happening in _NBA 2K26_, across all Gen 9 and Gen 8 platforms.

For the first time ever, you’ll be able to collect and play with WNBA Player Cards, and pair them with your favorite NBA superstars on the same team. This is a massive milestone in _NBA 2K_ history and it’s been a long time coming.

While this is a major addition, it’s not the only one in _2K26_. This year features new Game Changer Cards, All-Star Team-Up, a new arena featuring your MyTEAM accolades, and much more! So without further ado, let’s break down MyTEAM in _NBA 2K26_.

## **THE WNBA JOINS MyTEAM**

For the first time in _NBA 2K_ history, the WNBA is officially joining MyTEAM in _NBA 2K26_!

This monumental milestone means that you can form unique pairings between Jalen Brunson and Angel Reese, Lisa Leslie and Nikola Jokić, and countless others! Imagine throwing a lob with Paige Bueckers to Cooper Flagg, or torching the defense dropping 4-pointers with Stephen Curry and Caitlin Clark as your backcourt tandem.

The WNBA is fully integrated into every aspect of MyTEAM’s features and game modes. Experiment with lineup combinations the sport has never seen before and get creative as you find the perfect balance for each format.

Attributes and Badges function identically for all WNBA and NBA Player Cards, ensuring a balanced and consistent gameplay experience regardless of who you’re controlling. In addition to mixing and matching WNBA and NBA superstars, all WNBA uniforms have been added along with the entire league’s set of court floors. These courts include an added NBA three-point line to maintain a seamless experience across all MyTEAM competitive modes.

Now with WNBA inclusion in MyTEAM, we’ve added a dedicated WNBA Domination tier, where you can compete against the league using a lineup of WNBA stars. Create a lineup featuring exclusively WNBA players and challenge teams around the Association to earn those coveted Domination stars and crests for rewards.

These never-before-seen lineups wouldn’t be the same without a colorful broadcast crew to capture the magnitude of NBA and WNBA players competing side-by-side. _NBA 2K26_ presentation has been updated with the iconic voices of Kevin Harlan, Greg Anthony, and Stan Van Gundy, including new commentary and reactions to deliver their patented dynamic and insightful coverage.\* Feel the energy and excitement of WNBA and NBA stars coming together in this groundbreaking MyTEAM development.

## ALL-NEW GAME CHANGER CARDS

WNBA Player Cards entering the MyTEAM landscape will open the realm of possibility in Domination and throughout the entire mode—but they’re not the only difference-maker being introduced in _2K26_.

This year welcomes all-new Game Changer Cards, a brand new type of card that’s different from anything you’ve ever encountered before. These cards give you the power to cater your MyTEAM experience to your liking, with increased rewards and making your Player Cards more powerful.

These consumable cards grant special power-ups, including:

- Activating a REP or MyTEAM Points multiplier for your next game.
- Recovering a win streak in Showdown after a loss.
- Auto-winning a Breakout game without playing it.
- Earning an extra prize or recovering a loss during a Breakout run.
- Instantly completing an Exhibition Mission.
- Auto-evolving an Evolution card.
- Reducing the difficulty or target score differential in Domination.
- …and **_dozens_** more!

![ALL-NEW GAME CHANGER CARDS](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/6g8Won0ahSpp8MeEqjtTwI/fb854a9d62ba402284a0db0c24623994/N26-ALL-GAME_CHANGER_CARDS-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1080x1920-FINAL.jpg)

MyTEAM in _2K26_ is a game changer, literally and figuratively. Approach the game with the mindset to break the mold and play your way. Rethink the way MyTEAM is played and find an angle that no one else has discovered.

Get a head start with Game Changer cards in _NBA 2K26_ by completing the _2K26_ Challenge in _2K25_’s MyTEAM right now! On top of selecting an All-Star Series 1 player for your collection, you will also receive 5 Game Changer cards that each double your MyTEAM Points earned in a game in various MyTEAM modes. This is a great way to get started and build your MTP for the Auction House! Learn how to participate in the challenge below:

1. Enter Locker Code "2K26-COVER-ATHLETES-MyTEAM" for a 100 OVR Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Invincible Carmelo Anthony, and Pink Diamond Angel Reese Coach Card in _2K25_.
2. Head to Lifetime Challenges in MyTEAM and play the " _2K26_ MyTEAM Challenge" using 100 OVR Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Invincible Carmelo Anthony in your lineup.
3. Defeat previous _NBA 2K_ cover athletes in a Triple Threat game to 21 points and earn Invincible Devin Booker.
4. When you download and play _2K26_, an All-Star Option Pack and 5 Game Changer cards will be waiting for you.

Make sure to take advantage of this offer before it expires on Friday, August 22, 2025 at 8 a.m. PT!

## TRIPLE THREAT PARK AT NIGHT\*

In _NBA 2K26_ the sound of waves lapping and the sunbaked courts from _NBA 2K15_’s Sunset Beach are returning with a remixed look and feel. When the sun sets on this gorgeous venue, Triple Threat Park will come alive with neon lights that accent the tropical environment.

Triple Threat Park boasts four head-to-head 3v3 courts, including a new one on the newly opened boardwalk near the beach. At the center of the park, there are three 3v3 courts for 6-player co-op games.

Based on community feedback, the top REP player on your team will provide your uniforms and the top REP player in the game will bring their basketball.

![TRIPLE THREAT PARK AT NIGHT](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/19wOpdwTkLSGh6eON3ohd1/89deddbde96cf9f71379cb128d1599a5/N25-ALL-TRIPLE_THREAT_PARK_ENVIRONMENT-NA-06-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-644x424-FINAL.gif)

###### **Team Up in 2v2**

Another first in MyTEAM: 2v2 games!

By the MyTEAM Store and Showcase Spot, you’ll find two all-new 2v2 half-courts in the middle of the street with chain nets.

These are co-op style games, where each person controls 1 Player Card. Grab your duo and lock in for “make it, take it” games where every possession matters.

###### **More Rewards**

Community-favorite reward mechanics for going on win streaks and climbing the seasonal wins ladder return and are expanded. Daily Win Streak rewards can now stretch beyond the three prizes earned every day during _2K25_, with even more prizing available each day and during events in _2K26_.

Earn more rewards with every W each Season, with Seasonal Ladder prizes available directly from the Triple Threat Park menu. In addition to easily accessible rewards, the final reward of each Season is repeatable for unlimited rewards!

Finally, daily Streak Busters are coming to Triple Threat Park. These are rewards for shutting down win streaks of increasing length. When you break an opponent’s streak, you’ll earn all the rewards from the tiers below. For example, if you break a 15-game streak, you’ll earn the rewards for breaking a 5-game, 10-game, and 15-game streak all at once.

## ALL-STAR TEAM-UP\*

Tell your friends: MyTEAM is the new home of All-Star Team-Up in _2K26_!

In All-Star Team-Up you can compete in 10-player, 5v5 co-op games with your friends, or random players. These fast-paced games feature 6-minute halves and can be accessed from a portal in Triple Threat Park or from the MyTEAM menu.

![LOBBY ](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1LiFgljsf6DbWnOwfCGL7c/fb374384316c3e1b582e81ac4ef713d4/N25-ALL-ASTU_LOBBY-NA-06-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-644x424-FINAL.gif)

All-Star Team-Up requires that you and four teammates each prioritize your five favorite NBA or WNBA Player Cards—they must be position eligible—and just like in Triple Threat Park, whoever has the highest REP will have the first choice.

Accumulate new rewards individually with a new Season Ladder, with the same repeating final prize mechanic as Triple Threat Park.

You can also earn rewards as a team by defeating opposing teams to collect wins. For every 5 games you win with the same squad, everyone will receive a reward, even if the wins aren’t consecutive. Develop chemistry on the court with your squad and climb the Seasonal rewards ladder together.

## KING OF THE COURT, PRESENTED BY AT&T\*\*

King of the Court is where the best of the best in MyTEAM compete for the best rewards and we’re taking it to the next level on Gen 9 platforms.

In _NBA 2K26_, King of the Court boasts a $10,000 USD (and 1 Million VC) grand prize every weekend for the No. 1 finisher across PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X\|S, from September 12 through August 2. No. 1 finishers on PC and Nintendo Switch 2 will each receive 1 Million VC.

Based on community feedback, it is now easier to participate. First, we’ve expanded King of the Court to take place during a full-weekend window, starting Fridays at 3:00 pm Pacific Time until Sundays at 11:59 pm Pacific Time, to be more accessible.

The qualification criteria is also simpler and now checks to see how much REP you’ve earned in the preceding week, allowing you to qualify by playing in any MyTEAM mode or by completing Challenges.

Once you enter King of the Court games, you will notice that the game difficulty will be set to a more competitive slider set compared to MyTEAM’s other multiplayer modes. Be sure to practice your Player Cards’ shots before jumping in!

The leaderboard ranks the sum of each player’s four best Game Scores during that weekend, with four tiers of rewards each event. Three losses will freeze your score, similar to _2K25_. Tier requirements are loosely based on the 1%, 10%, and 50% thresholds from _2K25_; however, they will lock in hours before the end of the event to prevent score fluctuation as the remaining games are finalized at the buzzer.

Continue beating your own high scores to climb the leaderboard. Even if you don’t win the grand prize, everyone who qualifies and plays three games, win or lose, takes home a reward.

## _BREAKOUT: GAUNTLET_

Another new game mode within Breakout is Gauntlet, where you put your entire collection to the test by completing games of increasing difficulty.

Gauntlet features a new straight-line game board—but there’s a twist. As you progress from Rookie difficulty to more challenging difficulties, you’ll only be able to use each of your Player Cards once per run. With Triple Threat, Clutch Time, and quick Full Lineup games, depth is your friend in this game mode, but so is understanding how to maximize every card in your collection.

Each game has Objectives that can be completed to return eligibility for a random card you’ve already used during this run. As the difficulty gets higher, more Objectives will become available each game, giving you more opportunities to gain back some of your used Player Cards.

The longer you continue a run, the better the rewards will be with a regularly updated final reward at the end of the path. There are prize games along the sides of the board every three spots, so after every three wins, you can optionally go up against gatekeeper teams to earn  rewards.

![BREAKOUT: GAUNTLET](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/6ElmSAxZpsDYzTllR0wkod/1334f61737132ec4b7320878373d39ed/N26-ALL-BREAKOUT_GAUNTLET-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

###### **More Breakout Improvements**

Based on community feedback, Breakout as a whole is even more rewarding in _2K26_. Facing a gatekeeper team in Breakout no longer ends your run and instead takes away one of your three allowed prizes or losses, so you can continue playing on boards to earn up to three rewards in each run.

As you unlock neighboring spots on Breakout boards, you’ll notice new reward mini-game spots to receive Ball Drops, Ascension picks, Wheel Spins, Door Game searches, or Vault openings! Redeeming these free spots does not count towards your three prizes or losses per run—they’re simply more rewards available on the board!

With these free spots being added, it could be a lot more difficult to trigger warps to other boards with fewer games available. To counter this, Breakout will see more focused and frequent updates to the lineup classes available on the initial board. Teams from the 1980s may be featured with their warp board available, while another update could see brand new lineup classes added with never-before-seen opponents for your lineups. New triggers have also been added to generate warps, but those will need to be discovered by the community.

## SINGLE PLAYER SALARY CAP

Salary Cap mode returns in _NBA 2K26_—now with the option to play in single player games. The AI opponents you’ll face in single player games are real lineups created by other community members under the same salary cap restrictions.

Both single-player Salary Cap and multiplayer Salary Cap Online feature the same rewards track, but multiplayer games grant double Round Points for faster progression. Higher single-player difficulties also have the ability to speed up your progress in comparison to lower difficulties.

Similar to the updates in Triple Threat Park and All-Star Team-Up, Salary Cap’s round-based prizing will also include a repeatable final reward, just in case you can’t get enough Salary Cap action with its unique game format of two halves and a fixed-score ending.

Bridge the gap between single-player and multiplayer modes to keep things fresh and exciting in _2K26_.

## **GETTING STARTED**

At the start of your MyTEAM journey, choose between two 5-card lineups to play as, each with a mix of current and historic NBA and WNBA players.

Test these cards in a quick, 3-minute game and afterwards you’ll receive two Free Agent Option Packs, one with Diamond-rated Current Players that can be used for 25 games, and the other with Pink Diamond-rated Legend Players that can be used for 15 games. These option packs will include the NBA and WNBA cards in the game you just played.

For new or returning players, start your collection with rewards from the MyTEAM Tutorial. Here, you will experience the basics of MyTEAM _2K26_, from the new Coaching staff features, upgrading your player cards, and earning a Clutch Time lineup’s worth of players. Plus, this is how you earn the first of the five traditional evolution Starter players!

## MyTEAM ARENA\*

Bask in all of your achievements in the new starting location on Gen 9 platforms—the MyTEAM Arena.

This arena proudly displays banners, trophies, and murals from all of your accomplishments on the court and across the mode. This includes reaching Level 40 in a Season, getting promoted to Tier 1 in Showdown, collecting all the Player Card gems, completing feats across all MyTEAM modes, and more. Plus, there are special additions for the talented few that win King of the Court, or reach the Dark Matter Tier in MyTEAM REP.

Your MyTEAM Arena features lots of natural light and stunning views of the neighboring buildings. Pack your stadium with dedicated fans as you progress and continue playing MyTEAM.

The MyTEAM Arena is the initial home for every MyTEAM this year. NBA arenas will still be available to swap in, but the MyTEAM Arena is your trophy room and home turf.

![MyTEAM ARENA](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/43pxcR0FMfFnqb6gf1Ye45/2587027e1663ccd6266025d531a0f031/N26-ALL-MYTEAM_ARENA-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

## COACH DEVELOPMENT

In addition to getting Badge Cards from packs or the Auction House, there is a new way you can invest in and improve your Player Cards. In _2K26_, you can build out your coaching staff with up to five Coach Cards and expand a new skill tree to unlock powerful badges to add to your Player Cards.

Coach Cards now have five categories for you to prioritize: Strategy, Leadership, Mentorship, Knowledge, and Team Management. You choose which category to assign your coach in your franchise, which will unlock Badge Training Challenges. The higher your Coach Card’s gem level & skills, the more powerful badges you can access by redeeming Coach Points.

Coach Points will be made available at every REP tier and from Season Rewards. Redeem them wisely in your coach’s assigned category to unlock the badges that will help your Player Cards the most. If you decide to make a coaching change, your unlocked progress will remain even if you decide to swap Coach Cards or move your coach to a different category. As you increase your REP level, you will open more slots to add to your coaching staff, making more Badge Training Challenges available.

Once unlocked, Badge Training Challenges can be started from the Challenges menu. Select which player you want to add the badge to and complete an in-game challenge with them to add it, no Badge Cards required!

Coach Cards will continue to provide in-game boosts in certain situations or for the entire game. If you have multiple active Coach Cards on your staff, selecting a Head Coach will grant access to that coach’s in-game boost.

![COACH DEVELOPMENT](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/52uAqFgdNBJzV2raZkWwE6/d3970ae3a7e329fc511f56f70eec74a4/N26-ALL-COACH_DEVELOPMENT-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

## VICTORY CARDS & THE EXCHANGE

When you win a game in MyTEAM’s competitive modes (Showdown, Salary Cap Online, and King of the Court) you will earn a Victory Card that not only has the REP gem tier of the opponent you beat, but also their team logo, game date, final score, game mode, and whether or not the opponent rage quit!

Conquer opponents with high REP levels, collect their Victory Cards, and exchange them for rewards in The Exchange.

![VICTORY CARD](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1nzbRM3Ps8B0YxZk0HcZps/2a6d479b34911d4f38ac97d4b2a79237/N26-ALL-VICTORY_CARDS_AND_THE_EXCHANGE-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

There are also new ways to exchange your cards and receive rewards for duplicates or unused cards in your collection.

New OVR-based Exchanges may accept player cards of any gem tier, but the average rating of those cards must meet a minimum OVR rating. Exchange Chains must be done consecutively for more powerful rewards. Finally, Exchange Groups are multiple exchanges within a category and completing them all will earn you an additional group reward.

Based on community feedback, Exchanges can now also access the cards in your My Auctions menu (which can again be expanded by REPing up this year) where more cards can be stored before being swapped for rewards.

## MyTEAM REP

REP is a status indicator in many respects throughout MyTEAM, and to see so many members of the community showcase their REP rewards, like the MyTEAM Coliseum and player banners, means a lot to us here at Visual Concepts. We’re excited to immortalize our Top REP players from _2K25_ on the Top REP Court which is included in everyone’s starter kit in _2K26_.

Shortening the grind between REP rewards was a common feedback item from the community. This year, many of the REP tiers now have multiple sub-tiers so that you can earn more rewards, more often.

Reach Dark Matter REP in 2K26 to earn a group of truly ‘Out of this World’ rewards, and one of the most iconic Carmelo Anthony aliases of all time: **_G.O.A.T. Hoodie Melo!_**

![G.O.A.T. Hoodie Melo](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/zXk4VMkTv9psuR1muULeL/43e5551da1a0190708d3ef4decf7f245/N26-ALL-HOODIE_MELO-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

## …AND MORE!

###### **More Showdown Rewards**

Showdown returns with weekly rewards giving you the choice between three rewards based on how many wins you get that week. This year, you can preview the weekly rewards available in the different tiers, helping you chart your path to the increased rewards in the higher tiers.

As you reach a promotion to a new tier, you will receive new rewards immediately when you rank up. Plus, the Season Win rewards have been expanded with more rewards for more wins.

###### **Domination Update**

Domination now features new looks and formats, and a new reward called Crests. Every Domination game now includes an extra challenge available at the 3 Star difficulty. Complete the challenge and win by the listed score differential to unlock that game’s Crest. If you complete all 99 stars and all 33 Crests in a Domination, you’ll earn a reward worthy of its ultimate players.

Domination will launch with two sets this year representing the current NBA and the current WNBA leagues. As previously mentioned, WNBA Domination will need your lineup to be full of WNBA players to be eligible.

###### **New Player Card View**

Viewing, upgrading, or swapping your Player Cards has never looked so good in MyTEAM. When you click the right stick to view a card, it will expand into different layers that reveal attributes, Badges, Shoes, and Evolution requirements while the player is added to the menu replacing the photo cutout. This is your new one-stop-shop for editing your Player Cards.

This new Player Card view is also featured whenever you swap cards in a lineup. Improved attribute comparisons give you a quick way to compare strengths and weaknesses of different cards, along with both players on screen.

###### **Favorite Cards in Your Collection**

Use the new Favorite feature to bookmark Player Cards and bring them to the forefront of your collection when swapping players. A new Autofill with Favorite Players has been added to quickly add these players to a new lineup, and they will be on display in the My Collection menu as well.

###### **Presentation Updates to Eras**

Triple Threat and Clutch Time era games in Breakout and Challenges now have historic court floors to match the Eras filter and opponents for that game. Plus, some new screen filters have been added for a unique twist in Challenge games. Clutch Time across MyTEAM is also returning to a 14 second shot clock, based on community feedback.

![Presentation Updates to Eras](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/3NaraRkZXtfAZCB2OMr1Cc/a9eaa1adc33f88c3e3cc4d861b1d6536/N26-ALL-PRESENTATION_UPDATE_TO_ERAS-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

###### **Cinematic Walkout Reveals**

Still-frames are out and cinematic player walkout reveals are back, and now supporting two or more players walking out to celebrate together!

![Walkout ](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1E0IajhfJa4i4uqqN5P1io/c9eb31f5c4b886b8a64ec689295c2b71/N25-ALL-WALK_OUT_REVEALS-NA-06-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1920x1080-FINAL.gif)

## COMING UP NEXT

Unite stars in MyTEAM this year with NBA and WNBA Player Cards. Collect players from both leagues and form never-before-seen lineup combinations. We can’t wait to see what the community comes up with—and we can’t wait to share what’s coming down the pipeline.

In case you missed, see what’s new in the [MyPLAYER Builder Courtside Report](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myplayer-builder/), and keep an eye out for The W Courtside Report.

Get up to 7 days of Early Access\*\*\* when you [pre-order](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/buy/) the _Superstar_ or _Leave No Doubt Edition_, and receive additional bonus content!

# NBA 2K26: Season 7 Courtside Report

Est. Read Time4 minutes, 4 seconds

SHARE ON SOCIAL

Season 7 sets the stage for new beginnings in the WNBA, and celebrates the climactic conclusion to the NBA postseason with new MyCAREER and MyTEAM rewards.

Accept & Play

By clicking play, you agree to [YouTube's privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy) and the transfer of data to Google servers.

Every play, every game, every Season has led to this moment.

Season 7 sets the stage for new beginnings in the WNBA, and celebrates the climactic conclusion to the NBA postseason with championship-caliber MyCAREER rewards, all-new MyTEAM cards, exhilarating events, and more!

Prepare for a new season of storylines, team up with _NBA 2K26_ cover star Angel Reese, and rise to the occasion in The City to prove you’re worthy of the glory.

## **MyCAREER**

Angel Reese is turning the page and starting a new chapter with the Atlanta Dream; whether you’re writing your legacy with the franchise that drafted you or adding to the storied history of a different team, you have the power to shape your narrative in MyCAREER. Embrace the pressure that comes with carrying a franchise, leading your Crew, and maintaining your status as the Park MVP. Season 7 features a host of fresh MyCAREER content, and those who stay cool in the clutch are sure to reap the rewards.

###### **Show Your Grit at Rivet City Park**

Steel your nerves and lead your Crew under pressure at the Rivet City Park, where the best forge their status as Park MVP. Manufacture athletic highlights, go on a winning streak with friends, and build your way up the leaderboard.

![Greatness ](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/79eShkLjAmVQU15QvESdI6/6979722ad8a1bca889975648c3cbee03/GreatnessLogo.png)

###### How to Complete the MyTEAM Greatness Challenges

Earn the first 100 OVR player in _NBA 2K26_, Dwyane Wade, plus over 250 Player Cards by conquering the all-new Greatness Challenges in MyTEAM.

![The Greatness Challenge](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/3sbfgXq8YW2yEtWHEcRNmR/8996f88f59f593796c1f4eae0df31d5f/GREATNESSCHALLENGE__1_.jpg)

Greatness Challenges are divided into five series, each focused on a different playstyle to dominate the court: Shooters, Heatwave Scorers, Playmakers, Slashers, and Defenders.

Each series can be completed at your own pace and rewards a powerful Dark Matter player when finished. You can focus on one playstyle, jump between them, or even progress through multiple challenges at the same time as you earn new cards at every step.

- Play your favorite MyTEAM modes and rack up each playstyle’s required stat to earn 40+ new Greatness Player Cards.
- Use each Greatness player to win a Challenge Game inspired by one of their most exciting real-life performances. Completing these games earns you over 200 Player Cards featuring legendary masters of each playstyle.
- Push your skills further by completing additional challenges using the Player Cards you’ve unlocked along the way.
- Finish an entire playstyle series to unlock a new 99 OVR Dark Matter player.
  - Stephen Curry
  - Allen Iverson
  - Larry Bird
  - Blake Griffin
  - Kevin Garnett
- Choose your path and collect all five Dark Matter players to earn 100 OVR Dwyane Wade!

Accept & Play

# NBA 2K26: Season 8 Courtside Report

Est. Read Time6 minutes, 48 seconds

SHARE ON SOCIAL

Season 8 tips off with the start of the NBA offseason, the WNBA in full swing, and a wave of new MyCAREER and MyTEAM rewards to celebrate an eventful summer.

Accept & Play

By clicking play, you agree to [YouTube's privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy) and the transfer of data to Google servers.

The quest to become an NBA champion doesn’t start in the regular season—it starts in the offseason.

The early mornings in the weight room, long nights in the gym, and sleepless nights thinking about the Larry O’Brien trophy separate the greats from the best. With a new champion crowned, teams look to retool and regroup for next year’s title run. Superstars are on the move, and the basketball landscape is bracing for total transformation.

As the competition grows stronger, master your skills and become a dominant force like Season 8 hero Shaquille O’Neal, so you can impose your will when it matters most in The City\*, MyCAREER, and MyTEAM.

## **MyCAREER**

Shaquille O’Neal announced his arrival to the NBA in a big way, commanding the Orlando Magic and the paint with an unprecedented combination of power and athleticism. In four years with the Magic, O’Neal shattered backboards and expectations, despite already being a highly-touted No. 1 overall pick. His punishing playstyle on the court and decorated resume cemented him as one of the best big men of all time.

During Season 8, make an immediate impact like O’Neal and overpower the competition in MyCAREER, as you continue your pursuit of GOAT status. Flex all-new rewards with your Crew and put in the work to reach Level 40.

###### **Defend the Old Town Courts**

Grab your friends and defend your title as the Park MVP at the Old Town courts from _NBA 2K15_. Set in the heart of an urban neighborhood, patrol the paint as an enforcer and play with grit to clean the glass and motivate your team to victory. Climb your way up the rankings and tower over rival Crews at the top of the leaderboard.

# NBA 2K25: Season 8 Courtside Report

Est. Read Time5 minutes, 14 seconds

SHARE ON SOCIAL

Season 8 of NBA 2K25, starring three-time WNBA MVP A’ja Wilson, brings the heat and all-new MyCAREER and MyTEAM rewards.

Accept & Play

By clicking play, you agree to [YouTube's privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy) and the transfer of data to Google servers.

Season 8 of _NBA 2K25_ is bringing the heat this summer.

Suit up with Las Vegas Aces superstar A’ja Wilson during Season 8 of _NBA 2K25_, starting June 27, and team up with friends in The City (PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X\|S, PC) and The Neighborhood (PlayStation®4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch) as you compete for all-new MyCAREER and MyTEAM content.

The 2024-2025 NBA season was one to remember and led to sensational performances from budding superstars in the NBA Finals. Now that the Larry O’Brien trophy has been lifted, this summer now belongs to Wilson and her WNBA counterparts as they begin their quest for a WNBA championship. Enjoy heightened competition in The W Online\*, MyCAREER, MyTEAM and more this Season.

## **MyCAREER**

Only 28 years old and in the midst of her eighth WNBA season, A’ja Wilson’s Hall of Fame legacy continues to grow. With a Rookie of the Year award, three MVP trophies, two Defensive Player of the Year honors, six All-Star selections, and two WNBA championships to her name, there isn’t much Wilson hasn’t accomplished. The _NBA 2K25_ cover star is greatness personified and raises the bar every season—think you can match it? Grow your MyPLAYER’s legend in MyCAREER and see if you can follow in Wilson’s footsteps.

![N25 | Season 8 | Sentinel](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1jHpfeXY2UWJGJLtUDh9GZ/812a9342924f0747ee6c55560f1ea1ca/N25-S8-CITY_SENTINEL-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1920x1080.jpg)

Check out some of the rewards available during Season 8:

- Level 14 Pocket Bike
- Level 20 ‘The Coyote’ - San Antonio Spurs Mascot
- Level 21 15% REP Boosted REC Headband Tie (NG)
- Level 23 Golden Patch Hairstyle
- Level 36 Nike A’One Shoe
- Level 38 Life Jacket
- Level 39 City Sentinel
- Level 40 +1 Cap Breaker (NG)

Step into greatness with the **Level 36 Nike A’One Shoe.** Designed to stand out with wavy details and a vivid hot pink colorway, lace up Wilson’s iconic signature shoe and channel her remarkable talent during Season 8. Stop by Legend Sports in-game to find some complementary drip to accentuate the shoes, and show your support for The W with the WNBPA Ball.

![N25 | Season 8 | NIKE AONE SHOE](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/7ucAPv6m4o0ATeCotZazUU/d444e4b5de2895bd8926fe5cc07b897e/N25-S8-NIKE_AONE_SHOE-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1920x1080.jpg)

The competition in The City this Season will be stifling, but that shouldn’t stop you from heating up. Torch anyone who stands in your way and show your flair with fresh cosmetics on and off the court.

## **MyTEAM**

Turn up the heat in Season 8 with new, sizzling MyTEAM cards and rewards. Tower over rival players and blot out their shot attempts with athletic big man Bam Adebayo. The **Level 1 100 OVR Bam Adebayo** card boasts a commanding presence in the paint and can serve as a formidable defensive anchor for your squad. Offensively, cook the competition with Adebayo’s well-rounded post- and mid-range game, or neutralize defenders with high-screen pick-and-rolls. Insert the three-time All-Star into your lineup and watch your MyTEAM flourish on the court.

![N25 | Season 8 | BAM ADEBAYO](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/5cAkcoIbxp6nUYHkfOm6mW/9a29d9bd89bd2eebd75fe3f287beb053/N25-S8-BAM_ADEBAYO-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1920X1080.jpg)

Show some love to an era known for peace and love with throwback All-Star and dominant power forward Larry Kenon. During the early-to-mid-70s, Larry Kenon was a force to be reckoned with on the San Antonio Spurs. In 399 games with the franchise, the power forward averaged 20.7 points and 10.3 rebounds per game—a certified bucket-getter and glass-cleaner. Add the **Level 10 100 OVR Larry Kenon** card to your collection and unleash this blast from the past against modern NBA stars.

He may have ice in his veins but **Level 20 100 OVR D’Angelo Russell** can get red-hot from behind the arc. Leverage pick-and-rolls or run designed plays to get Russell open to fire a barrage of three-pointers with his effortless release. Let the crafty point guard facilitate your offense and dish out scintillating assists with pinpoint precision. Take advantage of the rangy guard’s high IQ and leave your opponent dazed and confused.

Well regarded as one of the premier sharp-shooting big men in the league, Brook Lopez, aka ‘Splash Mountain,’ offers a unique blend of three-point scoring and imposing shot-blocking. With a 35% career three-point percentage, drop shot after shot in the bottom of the bucket and douse any signs of momentum from the other team. The **Level 30 Invincible Brook Lopez** card will keep your MyTEAM calm, cool, and collected all summer long.

During his illustrious 16-year career, Julius Erving gave the league and fans a healthy dose of timeless highlights and unforgettable memories. ‘Dr. J’ dissected defenses at will every time he stepped on the hardwood, thanks to his surgical playmaking and gravity-defying athleticism. To close out the Season 8 rewards ladder, we’re prescribing the **G.O.A.T. Julius Erving** card to anyone who reaches Level 40. Add the four-time MVP and NBA champion to your lineup to give it a Hall of Fame pedigree.

![N25 | Season 8 | JULIUS ERVING](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/vhTAHJtXqN9ZQfKFBnHO2/16504290a0a473750faee0e6d343d460/N25-S8-JULIUS_ERVING-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1920X1080.jpg)

Take a look at some of the other rewards available in Season 8:

- **Level 4 Season 8 Ball and Uniforms**
- **Level 15 99+ OVR Premium Pack**
- **Levels 23 & 31 97+ OVR Pack Door Game**
- **Level 37 100 OVR Pack**
- **Level 38 Legend Badge Option Pack**

Roll out your new-look MyTEAM in Season 8 and compete to earn XP in single-player and multiplayer game modes.

## **THE W ONLINE\***

The fifth Commissioner’s Cup in WNBA history will be decided on July 1. The prestigious tournament features a clash of the titans and signifies a turning point in the WNBA season: when the competition level heightens and all eyes shift toward the All-Star Game. This year’s WNBA All-Star Game is set for July 19 in Indianapolis, Indiana, at Gainbridge Fieldhouse. But before the in-season tournament is decided and the All-Star rosters are set, let’s discuss all of the fun happening in The W during Season 8.

Take a look at some of the rewards below:

**Weekly Rewards**

- Silver Suit
- Firework Green Release Animation

- Leo Top + Necklace

**Season Rewards**

- Seattle Storm Say Her Name Jersey

Join forces with other players around the world and work together to complete Season 8’s Community Goal. Put your talent on display and chase the W all Season long.

## **SEASON 8 PRO PASS\*\***

![SEASON 8 PASS INFOGRAPHIC](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1lKVHbwPrmJ7ZTaiAyYMm8/d29cf3ea54c0a0bbfd4ad902a9e725b9/N25-S8-SEASON_PASS_INFOGRAPHIC-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1920x1080__1_.jpg)

Maximize your Season 8 experience with additional rewards and content through the Pro Pass. The Season 8 Pro Pass includes 40 extra tiers of MyCAREER and MyTEAM rewards, featuring cosmetic items, consumables, cards, and more! With your purchase of the Pro Pass, you’ll instantly receive a handful of automatic rewards, as well.

Season 8 Automatic Rewards:

Celebrate the conclusion of the 2024-2025 NBA season in style with a host of MyCAREER and MyTEAM rewards. Show your team spirit with the Indiana Pacers Mascot skin, rip all-new packs, and gain a competitive advantage with point guard eligible G.O.A.T. Julius Erving. # MyTEAM Courtside Report

Est. Read Time12 minutes, 45 seconds

SHARE ON SOCIAL

Become the best of the best in MyTEAM and assemble an elite lineup in NBA 2K25’s revamped mode, featuring the Auction House, Triple Threat Park, and more!

Accept & Play

By clicking play, you agree to [YouTube's privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy) and the transfer of data to Google servers.

Prove you’re the best of the best in MyTEAM.

_NBA 2K25_ challenges you to prove you’re the best of the best in the popular card-collecting mode, MyTEAM. _NBA 2K25_ adds four new game modes, a new year-long MyTEAM REP system with perks and rewards throughout the mode, dozens of quality of life updates, and the return of a major feature. MyTEAM in _NBA 2K25_ is the ultimate combination of new experiences and fan feedback. This year, there’s truly something for everyone, with intuitive functions to make getting in the game streamlined and easy.

# THE AUCTION HOUSE IS BACK

The Auction House returns in _NBA 2K25_ MyTEAM where you can auction off or acquire cards using MyTEAM Points (MTP) to enhance your Collection! New in _NBA 2K25_ the Auction House menu has been consolidated into a one-stop shop for searching, buying, and selling – no more exiting back to the MyTEAM menus to retrieve your completed Auctions or check on your Bids. You can also search for a selected card directly from your My Auctions menu, so you can easily check MTP prices before listing your card for sale. Need more space in your My Auctions menu? Earning more MyTEAM REP will increase your My Auctions capacity allowing you to get the most out of the Auction House.

![AUCTION HOUSE](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/6UDonNg1dJTOZB6PcfP9JY/d92d59b8bfda64bc4da26f9420503722/NBA25_ALL_MyTEAM_AUCTION_HOUSE_NA_05_ENUS_ESRB_AGN_1216x684_FINAL.gif)

To ensure a level playing field, the returning Auction House has a zero-tolerance policy on activity detrimental to the health of the mode. All transactions will go through a verification process to make sure the Auction House stays fun and fair for everyone in the community. The love for the MyTEAM Auction House is clear and we are excited for its return!

# TRIPLE THREAT PARK

Only available on New Gen, _NBA 2K25_ introduces one of the biggest upgrades to MyTEAM in its history—Triple Threat Park! Meet new friends face-to-face to team-up with or play against in the new home for Triple Threat Online and Triple Threat Online: Co-Op multiplayer games. Triple Threat Park will be accessible on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X\|S, and PC from within the MyTEAM menus or from The City. For the first time, you will take the court in Park gameplay with NBA Players while your MyPLAYERs cheer from the sidelines.

Triple Threat Park is a faithful remaster of _NBA 2K16_'s Rivet City Championship MyPARK, including details down to the iconic chain nets and glass walkways—this is one of the most iconic MyPARKs in _NBA 2K_ history! Like the original Rivet City rooftop, there are a total of nine courts. Four of these courts are for 2-player 3v3 games where each person controls a 3 Player Card lineup. The other five courts are for 6-player 3v3 Co-Op games where each person controls 1 Player Card, with two of these courts designated as “No Squad” courts.

![TRIPLE THREAT PARK](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/4LAnDItMM1NxSH7xajC07/b8c9d1bf3a524f708fb8c423babcfd48/NBA25_ALL_MyTEAM_TRIPLE_THREAT_PARK_NA_05_ENUS_NO_RATING_AGN_1216x684_FINAL.gif)

You can earn rewards in Triple Threat Park every day just by getting a win or going on win streaks, with even more rewards available from Challenges and Limited Time Events!

## Exploring Triple Threat Park

Show off your MyTEAM REP progress, your ranking from the last King of the Court event, your current Showdown tier, as well as your first choice Player Card on your customized Player Panel as you walk around Triple Threat Park as your MyPLAYER.

Once you approach a court's open Got Next spot, your MyPLAYER will walk onto the court and present your MyTEAM cards, which then reveal the NBA players you will be controlling.

# _**“Triple Threat Park is a faithful remaster of NBA 2K16’s Rivet City Championship”**_

Express your style with your MyPLAYER across both MyCAREER & MyTEAM as apparel and customizations earned through Season rewards now benefit Triple Threat Park as well. There is also a pop-up shop within Triple Threat Park where you can upgrade your swag and pick up new MyTEAM cards from the Pack Market.

## Showcase Spot

A special feature in Triple Threat Park is the Showcase Spot. If you step onto the Showcase Spot, you will open packs on a massive billboard for everyone to see. If you obtain a high-powered Player Card, that player will make a grand entrance complete with a fireworks display, visible to the entire Triple Threat Park.

![SHOWCASE](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/6uUZo3lyH6hzl3PSfAiVuH/358abb437e9ae9da0242d59b66ed0aae/NBA25_ALL_MyTEAM_SHOWCASE_FIREWORKS_NA_04_ENUS_NO_RATING_AGN_1216x684_FINAL.gif)

As an added bonus, the first time you use the Showcase Spot each day you’ll unlock 30 minutes of 2XREP for MyTEAM REP!

When you open packs through the pop-up shop or the MyTEAM store, the cards you obtain may be displayed live above your MyPLAYER. You can also show off your earned Player Cards by accessing your Unopened Packs menu from anywhere in Triple Threat Park. Once you open an award pack with a high level Player Card, the card art will appear over your MyPLAYER's head!

# BREAKOUT

Breakout is a new mode that houses the revamped single player experience in _NBA 2K25_ MyTEAM. After selecting a starting difficulty, you will begin in the middle of Breakout City, surrounded by various arenas representing game modes, eras, and opponents that you choose to compete against.

Your goal is to break out of the game board and earn your reward! Choose your direction to move and compete in a quick Triple Threat 3v3, Clutch Time 5v5, or a shortened 13-card Full Lineup game. Before starting a game, you can preview the game types and opponents. Discover the rewards available on the outer rim of the game board by unlocking the neighboring spot.

![BREAKOUT](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/3Hl7mYXulPJJqCd9cp1PVz/e110e5d1721684767a5dbaa48a1bf647/N25-ALL-MyTEAM_SCREEN_RESIZES-BREAKOUT-NA-STATIC-ENUS-ESRB-AGN-1216x684.jpg)

As you explore each board, you'll play against a range of opponents, including current NBA teams, historic teams in Era-themed games in the 1980s / 1990s / 2000s / 2010s, All-Time teams, and theme teams of new collections released throughout the year.

Wins earn Prize Points and progress in that direction on the board. In addition, each game has single-game Objectives to earn extra Prize Points. These Prize Points are needed to unlock the reward spaces on the board, and the spaces with the best rewards require more Prize Points before you can play those games. Choose your opponents and games wisely, because if you lose 3 times in a run you will need to start over.

As you move farther away from the center spot, the difficulty level goes up. Higher difficulties give more Objectives, which can shorten the number of games between you and your reward. Once you reach the outer edge, you will face off against a final gatekeeper team. These gatekeepers are the final run-ending opponents that stand between you and the reward you selected.

With the addition of Breakout, the standalone Triple Threat and Clutch Time modes have been retired and merged into this brand new, comprehensive experience. However, within Breakout, you can choose to play on boards that exclusively contain Triple Threat or Clutch Time games. Both Triple Threat and Clutch Time games are now played in the ‘House of Clutch’ arena, with Triple Threat games still using a smaller 3v3 court, but with fans behind the court-surrounding barriers and away from the action.

# SHOWDOWN

Showdown is a new head-to-head multiplayer mode in _NBA 2K25_ that draws inspiration from the competitive modes of previous MyTEAM years and will be replacing Unlimited.

Games are played with 13-card Full Lineups and 4-minute quarters. The core of this mode is a progression system across 15 tiers, where the primary goal is to win and get promoted. You will start at Tier 15 and work your way up to Tier 1 as you stack up wins. As an extra incentive, if you go on a win streak you will earn extra progression up the ladder. Losses will count against you, but there are checkpoints built into each Tier to protect your progress. Once you are promoted to a higher Tier, you cannot drop down a Tier during a Season.

![SHOWDOWN MODE](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/650cDQ6T1fIOXfDaMikPuw/87ba8447c562ff1670d039a607b2fc42/N25-ALL-MyTEAM_SCREEN_RESIZES-SHOWDOWN-NA-STATIC-ENUS-ESRB-AGN-1216x684.jpg)

Every Friday at 8 AM Pacific Time, if you have gotten a few wins in the last week, you will be able to choose a reward group based on the tier you are currently in. Getting even more wins each week will upgrade these reward selections. There are also rewards that are refreshed each Season that can be earned immediately as you reach those milestones. At the end of each 6-week Season, you will drop a number of tiers based on where you ended the Season, offering a fresh challenge the next Season without starting from scratch.

# _**"Showdown features an improved leaderboard that only considers games played between Tier 1 players. This will ensure the leaderboard accurately represents the best players in Showdown."**_

Showdown features an improved leaderboard that only considers games played between Tier 1 players. This will ensure the leaderboard accurately represents the best players in Showdown. Tiers also come into play for matchmaking, which will prioritize matching you up with opponents at a similar tier as you.

After you get a target amount of Showdown wins each week, you will qualify for our new competitive mode, King of the Court.

# KING OF THE COURT

King of the Court is an exclusive event held every Saturday from 10 AM to 2 PM Pacific Time, starting on September 14. To qualify, you must meet certain qualification thresholds in either the new Showdown or Triple Threat Park modes during the preceding week, or earn automatic qualification by rising up the MyTEAM REP tiers.

After each King of the Court game, you will earn a Game Score based on your performance. If you lose 3 games, your time in that Saturday's King of the Court will be over.

![KING OF THE COURT](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/7Fz3mAxBHezoblur6H62LH/578637b57811a7d9df2a62793586ff91/N25-ALL-MyTEAM_SCREEN_RESIZES-KING_OF_THE_COURT-NA-STATIC-ENUS-ESRB-AGN-1216x684.jpg)

Your final Game Score each Saturday will be ranked amongst all competitors in groups representing the Top 50%, Top 10%, Top 1%, and the ultimate #1 King of the Court. The group you finish in determines which tiers of rewards you receive. These rewards are some of the best available in MyTEAM and are refreshed weekly, including packs, MyTEAM-exclusive Indicator and Perfect Release Cards, and more including 1 Million VC for the King of the Court! Your accomplishments in the most recent King of the Court will also be proudly displayed on your MyPLAYER Player Panel while in Triple Threat Park.

This is where the best of the best in MyTEAM will compete!

# CHALLENGES

_NBA 2K25_’s MyTEAM combines Agendas and Challenges together into the new Challenges menu. This is your single stop for most of the live content updates that MyTEAM receives multiple times each week. Starting from the HOME tab, you will see three selected Challenges with rewards and your progress. At any given time, these will feature quick Challenges that can be completed in a single game, ones that may take a few games to complete, and Challenge Groups with greater rewards.

![CHALLENGES](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/4koJVyElP4W6J2Wu9JGkuX/9b0fa596c4f1acfda3848aa073b6ed77/N25-ALL-MyTEAM_SCREEN_RESIZES-CHALLENGES-NA-STATIC-ENUS-ESRB-AGN-1216x684.jpg)

It has never been easier to quickly get into a game in MyTEAM, as every mode can now use an Autofill lineup which automatically generates a lineup based on your collection. Typically these will use your best Player Cards available, but if a Challenge requires completing a specific stat like making threes or getting rebounds, this Autofill will adjust to ensure you have the best lineup for that Challenge.

These Challenges can link you directly to any valid MyTEAM mode to try and complete them in, or, you can select from a quick Pick-Up Triple Threat, Clutch Time, or Full Lineup game. Great if you just want to jump into a game and grind out a single Challenge without affecting your mode progress.

# MyTEAM REP

_NBA 2K25_ introduces a REP system to MyTEAM. REP serves as a year-long measure of success and does not reset like the 40 Levels in each Season.

There are 11 levels of MyTEAM REP Rewards, represented by the familiar MyTEAM Gem Colors, Bronze through Dark Matter. The MyTEAM REP menu also features a leaderboard of the Top Ten REP Players, designated with Invincible Logos, with No. 1 overall receiving the G.O.A.T. Logo. These REP Logos, regardless if you are in the Top Ten or making progress at your own pace, will appear beside you throughout MyTEAM.

![MyTEAM REP SYSTEM](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/72tkiHYkREPrUO8Dmps7ro/c77e3d362b516a7b4735b7edfa3181d4/N25-ALL-MyTEAM_SCREEN_RESIZES-MyTEAM_REP-NA-STATIC-ENUS-ESRB-AGN-1216x684.jpg)

You'll earn REP by completing games and Challenges, and there will be 2XREP events to give you a boost. You'll feel the progression of your team as you rise up the ranks in your MyTEAM journey this year. Each time you REP up, you will unlock new rewards, including access to the Auction House, expanded My Auctions capacity to hold more cards, returning rewards like the Fire Ball and MyTEAM Coliseum, regularly released free packs in the Pack Market, and an exclusive G.O.A.T. Jayson Tatum Player Card by reaching the Dark Matter tier! You can even earn automatic access to weekend King of the Court events without needing to qualify each week.

At the end of July, those who are ranked in the MyTEAM REP Top 10 as Invincible or G.O.A.T. level players will receive the ultimate rewards, related to NBA 2K26's MyTEAM mode. We will share more information on this later in the year!

# GETTING STARTED

When you first enter MyTEAM, you’ll see a brand new tutorial designed to teach you not only the basics of MyTEAM but, if you need it, also the basics of basketball and NBA 2K gameplay.

![GETTING STARTED](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/3MUpaAzyHKFwsn6oh2DorK/8674182dbd10a23e9debb29811dada15/N25-ALL-MyTEAM_SCREEN_RESIZES-GETTING_STARTED-NA-STATIC-ENUS-ESRB-AGN-1216x684.jpg)

First, you'll open your Starter Kit containing cards from your favorite NBA team and customize your team's name and city. You’ll get two Option Packs filled with All-NBA caliber Free Agent player cards included with each Starter Kit, no matter which team you select. Choose two Diamond-level Free Agent Current Players which will remain with your team for an extended 25 games. Then, choose an All-Time NBA legend Free Agent player, rated as a Pink Diamond, which will play 10 games with your MyTEAM before it expires.

You will then be asked what your experience with NBA 2K MyTEAM is. If you’re new to NBA 2K and playing on New Gen, you’ll be taken to the new [Learn 2K](https://nba.2k.com/2k25/courtside-report/gameplay/) tutorial to get started. If you’re familiar with NBA 2K but new to MyTEAM, you'll be guided through an introduction of the various MyTEAM modes, features, and lineup management, followed by Welcome to MyTEAM challenges. Maybe you already know what you're doing—you can choose to skip these introductions and get right into the action.

# _**"Even if you are an experienced MyTEAM player, there are some exclusive rewards including both Free Agent and Reward Player Cards to get you started, including the historic Trail Blazer pairing of Damian Lillard and LaMarcus Aldridge which have a Dynamic Duo boost."**_

Even if you are an experienced MyTEAM player, there are some exclusive rewards including both Free Agent and Reward Player Cards to get you started, including the historic Trail Blazer pairing of Damian Lillard and LaMarcus Aldridge which have a Dynamic Duo boost. Completing this mode tour will also reward you with an Option Pack where you can pick one of five Evolution players that can upgrade from Emerald, to Sapphire, to Ruby. All of these challenges will be available for you to complete on your own, if you decide to skip the tutorial.

# NEW MENUS AND UI

All of these changes and improvements in _NBA 2K25_ MyTEAM bring along new, streamlined menus.

![MyTEAM YOUR WAY](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/7x7QgM6opr9VDG8romn6Ff/06465ad40e822b4155404c0593d75410/NBA25_ALL_MyTEAM_NEW_MENU_AI_NA_07_ENUS_NO_RATING_AGN_1216x684_FINAL.gif)

When you start your MyTEAM journey, you'll find yourself on the HOME tab. Jump right in to Challenges and earn rewards right from the HOME tab. You can check on your Season & MyTEAM REP progress, and view active Limited Time Events here as well. If you skipped the introductions when first entering MyTEAM or want to revisit them, the Training Hub is where you can Replay Tutorials, watch Tips & Tricks videos, jump into Freestyle shootaround, or for the first time in MyTEAM, Practice Plays or run a Scrimmage with your MyTEAM lineup!

![MyTEAM TRAINING HUB](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/5WFLrbmc9SHLQA4dm87JuY/332b0ae8a670e2783ce62c663f2fbb2c/N25-ALL-MyTEAM_SCREEN_RESIZES-TRAINING_HUB-NA-STATIC-ENUS-ESRB-AGN-1216x684.jpg)

Single Player and Multiplayer game modes have been streamlined into a single PLAY tab. On PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X\|S, and PC you can dive into MyTEAM’s featured modes like Triple Threat Park, Breakout, Showdown, or King of the Court. You can also jump into more casual Salary Cap games, play in the latest Domination tiers, send players on Exhibition missions for rewards, or Play With Friends in Triple Threat or Showdown games.

The MARKET tab takes you to the Pack Market, Auction House, or The Exchange which features more flexible requirements and repeatable exchanges. This tab is also where you can enter Locker Codes.

Finally, the MANAGE tab is where you can access Lineups Management, My Collection, Edit Player, redeem 2XP Coins, and the MT Shoe Lab. New to _NBA 2K25_, you can also use the Customize HUD menu in the OPTIONS tab to fully adjust how your gameplay indicators, stamina bars, and more look in MyTEAM. You will be able to collect Indicator and Perfect Release Animation Cards to further customize what shows beneath your players’ feet and how you show off when getting a green shot in-game!

# AND SO MUCH MORE

Here are some more tidbits about what to expect in _NBA 2K25_:

## **Lineups Management & Coaching**

- Legend Badges, the new tier of Badges above Hall of Fame, are available in MyTEAM. Similar to Hall of Fame badges, Legend Badges skip the Bronze → Silver → Gold progression typically required when adding badge cards to players.
- Shoe Boost Cards have been replaced with Takeover Cards. Customize your Shoe Cards with any of your owned Takeover Cards and equip Shoes on each Player Card to customize which Takeover and Takeover Abilities it has access to.
- Some Coach Cards may now boost both your lineup's Badges and attribute ratings. Look for more powerful options throughout the year!
- Active Coach Boosts are now more obvious with an indicator that appears next to your players’ feet.
- Coach Settings now support customizing your Offensive Settings and your situational On-The-Fly Lineups (Bench, Tall, Quick, Defense, Three Point, Free Throw, and Custom), and setting your favorite plays.
- Some Free Agent limited-use Player Cards now have a variety of game limits, beyond just 5 games.
- You can now update all of your lineups’ uniforms, courts, arenas, or logos by using “Apply to All Lineups” from the Franchise tab.
- A new filter has been added when replacing cards in a lineup showing the most recently added cards in your Collection.

## **Card Collecting**

- Collector Challenges now primarily count cards that are “Locked In.” New in _NBA 2K25_, you can choose to lock in Player Cards individually, including ones that do not have a collection complete reward like Season Rewards to boost your collector count higher.
- The Exchange has received an overhaul allowing for more flexibility when adding Player Cards, more categories to easily find the Exchanges you are looking for, and a more visual menu to help identify the cards needed.
- When you unlock Ascension picks, you can now select multiple picks on the board and flip them all at the same time, rather than one by one.
- Most single-card Award Packs will now automatically open when they are rewarded, rather than filling up your Unopened Packs menu with dozens of packs each Season. For the packs that do go to Unopened Packs, a new fast-open option will quickly open the most recent packs to your collection.
- Event Cards may now include a description of what they are for, which is helpful in seek-and-collect events with Collection Rewards!

There are so many ways to be the best in MyTEAM in _NBA 2K25_. Play your way and level up your MyTEAM REP, compete against the MyTEAM community in Showdown and King of the Court, show off in the new Triple Threat Park, or earn exclusive rewards through Breakout. Acquire and Sell cards for MyTEAM Points on the returning Auction House, use the new Challenges menu to always find what’s next, and build the team of your dreams in MyTEAM.

_NBA 2K25_ welcomes a host of new features and enhancements to the NBA 2K franchise’s popular card-collecting mode, MyTEAM. In addition, there are several updates to [Gameplay](https://nba.2k.com/2k25/courtside-report/gameplay/), [MyCAREER](https://nba.2k.com/2k25/courtside-report/myplayer-and-mycareer/), [MyNBA](https://nba.2k.com/2k25/courtside-report/mynba/), and [The W](https://nba.2k.com/2k25/courtside-report/the-w/), which you can learn more about in each of the dedicated Courtside Reports. Be sure to check back for more information and news regarding _NBA 2K25_!

_\*Triple Threat Park and Learn 2K are only available on NBA 2K25 for PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X\|S, and PC._

# NBA 2K24 IS RETIRING

_NBA 2K24_ has been removed from all digital storefronts and is no longer available for purchase. To the community members who purchased a copy and invested their time and effort chasing greatness, we salute you.
